messages:
elaine: Quick heads-up — I'm opening a docs PR to consolidate the v1->v2 migration guidance for the /models and /chat endpoints. Will include: short checklist, TS+Python snippet diffs, model-swap behaviour note, and redirect rules for old links. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/XXXX :sparkles:

mike: Thanks! Can you call out the streaming framing changes? That was the main gotcha in last outage. A tiny snippet showing the new chunking would help.

elaine: Yep — adding a small example with the new event framing and a note about client libs that need the shim removed.

sam: FYI: engineering will flip the alias map on Monday at 09:00 PT. Docs should be live before that or we need a controlled redirect.

elaine: Good call — aiming to merge by EOD Friday. If not, we should gate the alias flip and keep legacy redirects for 48h.

ivy: Also add a troubleshooting section for embeddings users — model swap changes the tokenization/embedding size slightly, we saw a few regressed similarity ops. Include a short eval snippet to sanity-check.

elaine: Will do. Adding this checklist to the PR description so reviewers can tick off: 1) snippet tests pass, 2) redirects updated, 3) changelog entry, 4) sample app updated, 5) deprecation banner on v1 page.

mike: For snippet tests, add a small compat harness call in CI that runs the TS and Py examples against the staging router. If the output shape changes, fail the job (but allow opt-out with LABEL skip-compat).

elaine: Good suggestion — I'll add a job. Doc-bot, can you remind eng-releases tomorrow about the scheduled alias flip?

"doc-bot": Reminder scheduled: ping #eng-releases at 08:45 PT on 2164322060 for alias flip coordination.

sam: One more: clarify the recommended fallback policy in the migration doc — if dedicated-only models are requested, show how to set the routing policy to fallback to hosted-latency-tier or return a 402-like error. Little code snippet please.

elaine: Adding a small YAML config and SDK example for setting fallbackRoute: 

```yaml
routes:
  - name: default
    policy: local
    fallback: hosted-latency-tier
```

And SDK example: 
```js
const res = await client.generate({ model: 'rwd-legacy/v1', fallback: 'hosted-latency-tier' })
```

mike: Perfect. Please also include a short blurb about expected latency/cost tradeoffs for the fallback. Ops wants that for customer comms.

elaine: Will add estimated numbers from the perf dashboard (tokens/second and $/k tokens).

ivy: For the deprecation banner copy, propose: "Heads-up: v1 API will be deprecated on <date>. See migration guide for automated tools and snippets." Keep it short.

elaine: Drafting banner now; will paste into PR for quick UX review.

sam: After merge, let's run a quick link audit to ensure no internal docs point to the old v1 snippet files. I can run the crawler.

elaine: Awesome — assigning reviewers: @mike for runtime/compat, @ivy for embeddings notes, @sam for rollout timing. Thanks everyone — I'll ping when the PR is up for review. :thumbsup:
